Fast heuristic check for committed secrets. Not a substitute for dedicated scanners like gitleaks or trufflehog

Usage: kprun scan [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --path <PATH>   Directory inside the git repository to scan (default: current directory)
      --history       Additionally scan git history (git log -p, last 500 commits)
      --full-history  Scan the entire history without the 500-commit limit
      --json          Print findings as one compact JSON document on stdout
  -h, --help          Print help
